summary: Enhance your leadership skills with this Strategic Thinking and Decision-Making course. Learn to make informed decisions and drive your team to success.
lede: Decision-making training for leaders develops a structured way to assess complex choices, allocate resources, and turn strategy into action. For professionals responsible for organizational direction, it covers competitive analysis, decision trees and expected monetary value for risk assessment, and scenario planning to explore alternative futures and challenge cognitive bias.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically engineered for professionals who bear the responsibility of charting organizational direction, allocating significant capital, and navigating complex market disruptions.
prerequisites: This is an intermediate to advanced program designed for experienced professionals. You must have a minimum of five years of management experience and a working knowledge of corporate planning and basic financial metrics. No coding or advanced statistical background is required; you will use standard spreadsheet tools to construct decision matrices and evaluate quantitative models.
